thesis: This episode argues that legacy technology companies missed the early cloud opportunity due to internal dysfunction or a failure to recognize the value of their existing customer base, allowing AWS to dominate. While Google is characterized as an accidental monopoly with high margins but lacking enterprise sales competency, Microsoft is presented as having recovered from its early mistakes to secure a strong market position.
